{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Check how many rows remain
print(f"Rows after dropping missing values in flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g: {len(df_clean)}")

# Compute Pearson correlation
corr = df_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(df_clean['body_mass_g'])
print(f"Pearson correlation: {corr}")"}
